title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E4 — Mushrooms
Buckwheat crêpes filled with a mushroom mixture; vegetarian mushroom ragù served on rigatoni; French mushroom soup; mushroom risotto made with farro.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E5 — Sandwiches
Five classic sandwiches -- roasted chicken club, New Orleans po'boy with oysters, muffuletta, applewood-smoked bacon and fried egg sandwich, and a Reuben.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E7 — French Bistro Classics
Lamb navarin; Niçoise salad; a melted ham and cheese croque monsieur topped with a béchamel sauce; celery root rémoulade.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E8 — The Grind
Glazed meatloaf; hot Italian-style pork sausage; making burgers using a custom blend of meats; meatballs with ricotta.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E10 — West
Blum's coffee crunch cake; gâteau Basque, a dessert filled with pastry cream and cherries; pineapple upside-down cakes; date bars.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E11 — Southwest
Anise seed-flavored cookies called biscochitos; flan, a custard topped with caramel; tres leches cake.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E12 — South
Buttermilk pie; bourbon bread pudding; carrot cake with orange cream cheese frosting.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E1 — Updated Classics
Rhubarb and raspberry rye crisps; flaky buttermilk barley biscuits; spelt layer cake with whipped cream and berries.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E2 — Coffee Shop Favorites
Apple cider doughnut cake with whole grain wheat flour and applesauce; maple-glazed pumpkin spelt scones; seeded graham biscotti.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E3 — For the Cookie Jar
Pecan, oat and dark chocolate chunk cookies; chewy molasses crinkles; slice-and-bake buckwheat espresso cookies.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S8 E4 — Alternative Crusts
Plum galette with a cornmeal crust; dairy-free chocolate coconut pie; whole-wheat olive oil-crusted mushroom tart with tahini.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E3 — Amazing Houseplants
Martha brings the outdoors inside the home and shares her love of houseplants; she shows how to take care of the most popular houseplants and how to propagate them to create new plants.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E4 — The World of Succulents
Martha explores how to care for succulents including watering, fertilizing, and repotting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E5 — Inside Martha's Vegetable Greenhouse; Seed Starting
Martha takes us inside her vegetable greenhouse to see how she has turned her harvest into a year-round bounty; she collects, stores, and sows seeds, and makes her perfect green drink.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E6 — The Incredible World of Orchids
Martha visits the incredible Orchid Show at the New York Botanical Garden; this year's show immerses you in a mesmerizing array of orchids designed by acclaimed artist Lily Kwong.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E4 — Japanese Cuisine: Sushi, Sashimi and More
Martha visits the Japanese restaurant Joji in the heart of New York, where Chef George Ruan shares his secrets for the ultimate omakase experience; culinary giant Daniel Boulud stops by.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E5 — Brunch Favorites
Martha starts off brunch with a citrus cocktail Mary's knees; Chef Ignacio Mattos joins and makes an omelette with caviar and crème fraîche; Martha makes an endive salad; Martha makes waffles.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E6 — How to Make Croissants and Sourdough Bread
Martha journeys through her local area in search of the ultimate fresh-baked croissants and sourdough bread; learning about homemade bread and pastries.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E7 — One Pot Wonders With Jamie Oliver
Martha is in the test kitchen with English chef, restaurateur, and author Jamie Oliver, and they're cooking up a mouth-watering menu of dishes that are easy to make.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E10 — Perfect Burger Three Ways
Martha shares techniques for making the perfect burgers; Pat LaFrieda joins Martha to grind his beef mix; Thomas Joseph joins to make a hake fish burger and Martha shares her turkey burger.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E1 — Today's Catch: Fish Recipes for Everyday
Hannah Heimbuch and Martha demonstrate how to prepare fish for cooking; Chef Marcus Samuelsson makes cured king salmon and halibut en papillote; Martha breaks down a Dungeness crab.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E2 — India: A Tour of Food
Martha's friend and restaurateur, Shiva Natarajan, shares the key to making any Indian dish - spices; back in Martha's kitchen, they make butter chicken, lemon rice, and a tangy yogurt sauce.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S10 E50 — Halloween Creepy Crawlers
Marc Morrone discusses tarantulas, scorpions, crickets and hermit crabs; author Zarela Martinez; pork with mashed pumpkin.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S11 E44 — Cats; Bats; Ghosts; Goblins
Halloween: veil; transformations; spooky plants; white chocolate ghosts; spicy bat wings; collectibles; pop-up cards; sphinxes.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S11 E45 — Best of Pumpkin Ideas
Pumpkin: chicken pot pie in a pumpkin; pumpkinseed salad; flan; carving gourds; flower pots; heirlooms.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E6 — Halloween Pumpkins; Cookies; Costumes; Decorating
Carving pumpkins; Halloween cookies; costumes; face painting; decorating holiday door; trick or treaters at Turkey Hill.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E10 — Italian Favorites
Eight-layer pork ragù; béchamel-filled lasagna baked in ramekins; chicken Parmesan; raviolo with an egg yolk and ricotta-spinach filling; linguine with clam sauce.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E11 — On the Bone
Oxtail; slow-roasted beef ribs; cowboy steak; Korean short rib kebabs.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E13 — Lamb
Butterflied, rolled and roasted leg of lamb; lamb tagine with spiced butternut squash and prunes; yogurt-marinated lamb kebabs; seared loin lamb chops served with mint jelly and fried fingerling potatoes.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E1 — Eggs
Preparing eggs properly, no matter the style; frying eggs; omelet recipe; foolproof frittata.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E1 — Martha's Easy Foundation Landscaping Project
Martha redesigns the foundation landscaping around one of the homes on her Bedford Farm, providing step-by-step instructions on how to complete a successful landscaping project with ease and intent.
